content: Screener depth varies widely: Stock Rover ~650 metrics, TradingView ~168 criteria, Finviz ~80 filters. Common table-stakes columns across all three: price, market cap, P/E (trailing/forward), sector/industry, volume, % change (day/YTD). Finviz strong at technical/pattern-based screening; Stock Rover strong at fundamental screening + portfolio tracking; TradingView strong at charting. Most serious retail users combine tools (Finviz for screening, TradingView for charts).
